derivation: from a derivative of G984 (βλάπτω) and G5345 (φήμη);
def: scurrilious, i.e. calumnious (against men), or (specially) impious (against God)

occurrences.text: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
